summary_md: **小鱼学姐 ([@MoyuAI](https://x.com/MoyuAI/status/2115990068573995343))** describes **Orca**, which runs 30+ coding agents on the same task in separate worktrees and merges only the best result, warning about multiplied tokens and diffs and noting data collection can be turned off ([stablyai/orca](https://github.com/stablyai/orca)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - stablyai/orca: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
